name: Media Gateway (Art development copy)
description: Art-compatible media tools and provider-specific CLI capability discovery.
whenToUse: Query Dreamina, CapCut or Flow media capabilities, CLI connection, quote and job status.

gen_image.description: If no model is configured, tell the user and ask which model to use. Wait for their answer; never choose one yourself. Prepare text-to-image parameters. Unless the user names a model, use the exact modelId/providerId configured in the Art plugin settings; do not replace a subscription-only model merely because it is absent from the public catalog. Returns request.modelId/request.providerId; pass both unchanged to Core prepare as model_id/provider_id. Managed cindy-media:// or xdt-*:// results from Core can be displayed, reused, or passed through attachments directly; display each image once. Call resolve_local_path on mcp__cindy__media only when the user asks for a local path; never guess paths or scan the disk. Preserve explicitly requested size, resolution, quality and aspect ratio; use the selected model Guide to map parameters without silently reducing quality or resolution.
